# WhereAmI

### Modern Navigation & Teleport Plugin for Modern Paper Servers

> Find. Navigate. Teleport.

![Supports](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.20.x+-00AAFF?style=for-the-badge)
![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21-00AAFF?style=for-the-badge)
![Platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platforms-Paper%20%7C%20Purpur%20%7C%20Spigot-00AAFF?style=for-the-badge)
![Storage](https://img.shields.io/badge/Storage-SQLite-00AAFF?style=for-the-badge)

---

## ✨ Overview

**WhereAmI** is a modern, lightweight, and immersive navigation plugin designed for modern Paper servers.

Instead of outdated teleport plugins filled with chat spam and clunky UX, WhereAmI focuses on:

- Real-time directional HUD
- Responsive teleport GUI
- Death location tracking
- Smooth teleport systems
- Modern gameplay integration
- Lightweight performance

Built for:
- SMP servers
- Survival gameplay
- Modern server aesthetics
- Large player counts
- Immersive user experience

---

# 🧭 Directional Actionbar HUD

Never lose your home or death location again.

WhereAmI includes a real-time directional HUD directly in the actionbar:

```text
⬅ Home (245m)
↗ Death (890m)
```

### Features

- Dynamic directional arrows
- Real-time distance tracking
- Multiple navigation targets
- Lightweight update system
- Configurable refresh interval
- Survival-friendly immersive HUD

### Supported Directions

```text
⬆ ↗ ➡ ↘ ⬇ ↙ ⬅ ↖
```

---

# 🏠 Home System

Modern home management with responsive GUI support.

### Commands

```text
/sethome
/home
/homes
/delhome
```

### Features

- Multiple homes
- GUI-based home selector
- Rename homes
- Pagination support
- Persistent storage
- Fast teleportation

---

# ☠ Death Tracking

Automatically saves the player's last death location.

### Commands

```text
/death
/back
```

### Features

- Automatic death saving
- Directional death tracking
- Back teleport support
- Configurable cooldowns
- Optional teleport warmup

---

# ✈ Teleport Request System

A clean and modern teleport request experience.

### Commands

```text
/tpa <player>
/tpaccept
/tpdeny
```

### Features

- Teleport warmup
- Cancel on movement
- Clickable messages
- Countdown effects
- Sounds & particles
- Request timeout system

---

# 🖥 Modern GUI System

WhereAmI includes clean and responsive inventory GUIs.

### GUI Menus

- 🏠 Homes
- ☠ Last Death
- 🌍 Spawn
- 👥 Player Teleports
- 🧭 Navigation Settings

### Designed With

- Minimal modern layout
- Responsive interaction flow
- Clean visual hierarchy
- Lightweight rendering
- Premium gameplay feel

---

# ⚡ Performance Focused

Built for modern Paper servers.

### Technical Highlights

- Optimized actionbar scheduler
- Lightweight task handling
- SQLite storage
- UUID-based player data
- Java 21 architecture
- Adventure API support
- Modern Paper API implementation

---

# 🎯 Why WhereAmI?

Most teleport plugins were designed years ago.

WhereAmI was designed for modern Minecraft servers.

Instead of chat-heavy systems and outdated UX, WhereAmI focuses on:
- clean gameplay integration
- immersive navigation
- modern GUI systems
- lightweight performance
- smooth user experience
